listing.q: How long until my listing goes live?
listing.a: New and edited listings start as PENDING. An admin reviews AI flags and publishes LIVE listings, usually within one business day.

verification.q: How do I become a verified seller?
verification.a: Apply as a seller and submit verification documents. Verified means role SELLER and verification_status VERIFIED — they are separate statuses.

payment.a: All listing prices are shown in Ethiopian Birr (ETB). Boost and renewals will bill in ETB when those products launch.

about.title: About Bete
about.p1: Bete is an Ethiopian real estate marketplace built for buyers and sellers who want clear pricing in ETB, verified sellers, and listings that stay accountable.
about.p2: Every new or edited listing starts as PENDING. Admins review AI pre-screening flags before a property goes LIVE — AI never auto-approves or auto-rejects.
about.p3: We support Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, Somali, and English across the interface and city or category names.

help.title: Help
help.p1: Start here for common tasks on Bete.
help.p2: For account-specific issues, open a SUPPORT thread from the Support center.

safety.title: Safety
safety.intro: Treat every transaction with the same care you would offline. These practices keep buyers and sellers safer on Bete.
safety.rule1: Do not pay before viewing the property in person.
safety.rule2: Meet in daylight in a public place, or bring someone with you.
safety.rule3: Ask to see ownership documents before paying.
safety.rule4: Prefer in-app messaging over sharing financial details outside Bete.
safety.outro: If something feels wrong, leave the meeting and report the listing from the property page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: By using Bete you agree to post accurate listing information and to keep contact channels reachable while a listing is LIVE.
terms.p2: Listings may be REJECTED, REMOVED, or AUTO_HIDDEN when they violate marketplace rules or accumulate unresolved reports.
terms.p3: Seller verification is separate from role: only SELLER accounts with verification_status VERIFIED are shown as Verified Sellers.
terms.p4: Bete does not escrow funds. Payments between parties remain their responsibility.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Bete collects account details you provide — name, phone, email, and listing content — to operate the marketplace.
privacy.p2: View counts are deduplicated by listing, visitor key, and UTC date. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.p3: Soft-deleted accounts and listings are retained only as long as needed for moderation and legal obligations.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Write to the Bete team. For active listing disputes, prefer Support threads so we keep a record.
contact.sent: Message noted — we will follow up when the contact inbox is live.
